evidence_quotes: Edificação irregular em área de proteção aos mananciais.
Irregular building in protected watershed areas
rationale: This TJSP decision concerns an irregular building in a watershed protection zone ('Edificação irregular em área de proteção aos mananciais'), with jurisdiction referred to the Environmental Chamber. Under the mananciais-calibrated protocol, Brazilian watershed protection (áreas de proteção aos mananciais) cases are classified as WATER and mapped to environmental_protection. Under the strict service-access protocol rule, because this Brazilian case concerns only land-use/building enforcement in a mananciais zone without direct water utility service or abstraction/pollution adjudication, strict_service_access_label is marked UNCERTAIN and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false.
